_meta.owner: AI-1 (structure). Polygon values must be calibrated by operator.
_meta.coordinate_note: All polygon and line coordinates are in VIDEO PIXEL SPACE for the camera specified in camera_id. Different cameras have independent coordinate spaces.
_meta.calibration_status: TEMPLATE — all polygons are placeholders. Calibrate before running pipeline.

zones._comment: Entry area zone — covered by both entry cameras. Used for presence confirmation, not line crossing detection.
Billing zone — checkout counter and queue area. queue_depth is tracked here.
Product Zone A — first product section on the main floor. Update zone_id and sku_zone to match store 001 layout.png.
Product Zone B — second product section on the main floor.

entry_lines._comment: Primary entry line on CAM_ENTRY_01. Crossing this line determines ENTRY vs EXIT direction. This camera is the authoritative source per CONTRACT.md §13.
entry_lines._direction_note: inbound_direction is the direction a person moves when ENTERING the store. bottom_to_top means crossing from y > 500 to y < 500 is an ENTRY. The reverse is an EXIT.

entry_lines._comment: Secondary entry line on CAM_ENTRY_02. Used for confirmation and deduplication only (CONTRACT.md §13). Not authoritative.

camera_coverage._comment: Maps each camera_id to the zone_ids it can observe. Pipeline uses this to route zone containment checks to the correct camera.
